tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find animated UI components in the Foundry44 library by what they do (e.g. 'text reveal on scroll', 'cursor glow'). Returns names to pass to get_component.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Steps to add a Foundry44 component to the user's project, for any stack (plain HTML, React with or without shadcn, other), with its markup, options and pitfalls. Follow them in the user's project. Pro components need the user's Pro key in this server's Authorization header. Getting a Pro component c

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_component" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
